content.content: Undo steps the undone count one further back and moves the position to the pre-boundary of the operation it undoes, setting the redo bound to the pair count when it starts from nothing-undone; the pairs themselves stand.
content.rationale: The state undo leaves was fixed only inside specs/markers/undo.qnt's `undo` action, so a claim naming it had nothing smaller than the whole model to depend on. T-state fixes the four variables, G-select-undo which pre-boundary undo names, and T-undo the model this is read out of. The count steps by one so a further undo walks back one more operation, the bound marks the window's end, and the pairs stand, which leaves redo a pair to re-apply.
